en.summary: Dementia involves progressive memory and thinking changes. NHS: GP assessment and memory-clinic pathways; medicines are specialist-led — never invent doses. Emergency: sudden confusion (delirium), stroke symptoms, head injury after a fall, or inability to swallow with choking. Distinct from delirium-sudden-confusion entry.
emergencyIf: Sudden confusion with fever or new illness
seeDoctorIf: Progressive memory loss affecting daily life
doNot: Do not dismiss sudden confusion as 'just dementia'

fr.summary: Démence: troubles progressifs. Urgences si confusion brutale (délirium), signes d'AVC, chute avec traumatisme. Pas de posologies inventées.

he.summary: דמנציה: ירידה הדרגתית. חירום בבלבול פתאומי, סימני שבץ, חבלת ראש אחרי נפילה. אין מינונים מומצאים.

ru.summary: Деменция: прогрессирующие нарушения. Неотложка при внезапной спутанности, инсульте, ЧМТ после падения. Дозы не выдумывать.
